query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE lane_items SET sku = $2 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO lane_item_events (id, recorded_at, sequence, event_type, event, context) SELECT updated.id, COALESCE($3, NOW()), ROW_NUMBER() OVER () + $4, unnested.event_type, unnested.event, unnested.context FROM updated CROSS JOIN UNNEST($5::TEXT[], $6::JSONB[], $7::JSONB[]) AS unnested(event_type, event, context) RETURNING recorded_at
